title: plectranthus humulopsis
intro: Plectranthus humulopsis, commonly known as Mountain Balm, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Plectranthus humulopsis include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and calming respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
